about.description: Scala CLI is a command-line tool to interact with the Scala language. It lets you compile, run, test, and package your Scala code (and more!)
about.head: d1e9994

name: v1.19.0
body:
### Default Scala version is 3.10.1
Scala 3.10.1 is the new default Scala version, and the version Scala CLI itself is built with. The previous default was 3.9.0.

The legacy Scala 3.3 LTS line moves to 3.3.9. Tags such as `3.3.lts` stay pinned to the LTS versions configured in the Scala CLI build, so a tag cannot drift ahead of that configuration.

```bash
scala-cli -e 'println(scala.util.Properties.versionNumberString)'
# 3.10.1
```

```bash
scala-cli -e 'println(dotty.tools.dotc.config.Properties.simpleVersionString)' -S 3.3.lts --with-compiler
# 3.3.9
```

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4623, https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4574 and https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4576

### Built with JDK 25, GraalVM 25 for native images
Scala CLI is now built with JDK 25. The class files it publishes still target older Java versions, so a newer build JDK does not leak into the bytecode or the JDK API the code is allowed to call.

| Code | Compiler flag | Bytecode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Java sources in the main modules | `--release 17` (was `--release 16`) | 17 |
| Scala sources, other than the Scala 3.3 LTS modules | `-java-output-version:17` | 17 |
| `runner`, `test-runner` | `-java-output-version:11`, on Scala 3.3 LTS | 11 |
| `java-test-runner` | `--release 8` | 8 |
| `specification-level` | `-java-output-version:17`, on Scala 3.3 LTS | 17 |

`runner`, `test-runner` and `specification-level` stay on Scala 3.3 LTS with `-Yfuture-lazy-vals`. The JVM launcher still requires Java 17 or newer. Projects you compile with Scala CLI can still target older JVMs, for example with `--jvm 11` or `--jvm 8`.

Native images of Scala CLI are built with GraalVM Community 25.0.2. macOS x64 uses GraalVM 25.0.1, the newest Community build published for that platform.

`package --native-image` defaults to that same GraalVM. Pass `--graalvm-version` or `--graalvm-java-version` to pick another one.

```bash
scala-cli --power package --help
```

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4593

### `fmt` formats `.mill` files
`scala-cli fmt` formats Mill build files (`.mill`), alongside Scala sources and `build.sbt`. Pass a file or a directory.

```text title=mill-fmt/.scalafmt.conf
version = "3.11.5"
runner.dialect = scala3
```

```scala title=mill-fmt/build.mill
package build
import mill.*, scalalib.*
object foo    extends   ScalaModule:
  def scalaVersion    =       "3.3.6"
```

```bash
scala-cli fmt mill-fmt
cat mill-fmt/build.mill
```

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4554

### The `config` module is now built with Scala 3.9 LTS
As noted before, the `config` module was bumped to Scala 3.9.0 LTS. It used to be kept at 3.3 LTS for compatibility.

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4579

### ⚡ Exposing ports when packaging a Docker image
`--docker-exposed-ports` and `//> using packaging.dockerExposedPorts` declare the ports a Docker image exposes. A value can be a single port (`8080`), a range (`9000-9010`) or a port with a protocol (`53/udp`; `tcp` is used when the protocol is omitted).

```scala compile power title=HelloDocker.scala
//> using packaging.dockerExposedPorts 8080 9000-9010 53/udp

object Hello:
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    println("Hello")
```

```bash ignore
scala-cli --power package --docker HelloDocker.scala --docker-image-repository hello-docker --docker-exposed-ports 8080 --docker-exposed-ports 53/udp
```

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4586

### ⚡JSPI for Scala.js on Wasm
On the Wasm backend, `js.async` and `js.await` use JavaScript Promise Integration. Since Scala.js 1.22 the linker includes them only when JSPI is enabled. Turn it on with `--js-wasm-jspi` or `//> using wasmJspi`, together with Wasm output and ES modules. The runtime has to support JSPI as well. Node.js 25 and later enable it by default.

```scala compile power title=Async.scala
//> using wasm
//> using jsModuleKind es
//> using wasmJspi
import scala.scalajs.js

object Async:
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    js.async {
      val x = js.await(js.Promise.resolve[Int](21))
      println(s"JSPI ${x * 2}")
    }
```

```bash
scala-cli --power run Async.scala
# JSPI 42
```

<!-- Expected:
JSPI 42
-->

When the Scala.js linker emits several files, the entry module is now chosen deterministically, and a multi-file linked output directory is removed recursively before the next link.

Added by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4550, https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4548 and https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4549

### ⚡ Publishing on macOS, Linux ARM64 and Windows ARM64
`publish setup` and `github secret create` are now supported on MacOS (both Intel and ARM64), Linux ARM64 and Windows ARM64 platforms.

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4622

### Linux ARM64 `.deb` and `.rpm` packages
Linux ARM64 already had a native launcher. This release also publishes ARM64 Debian and RPM packages next to the existing x86_64 ones:

- [`scala-cli-aarch64-pc-linux.deb`](https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/releases/download/v1.19.0/scala-cli-aarch64-pc-linux.deb)
- [`scala-cli-aarch64-pc-linux.rpm`](https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/releases/download/v1.19.0/scala-cli-aarch64-pc-linux.rpm)

They are uploaded to the [scala-cli-packages](https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli-packages) apt and rpm repositories, together with other Linux artifacts.

Added by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4572

### Windows ARM64 launcher and MSI
A Windows ARM64 build is now published:

- [`scala-cli-aarch64-pc-win32-jvm.zip`](https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/releases/download/v1.19.0/scala-cli-aarch64-pc-win32-jvm.zip), a `jpackage` app image that bundles its own JVM
- [`scala-cli-aarch64-pc-win32.msi`](https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/releases/download/v1.19.0/scala-cli-aarch64-pc-win32.msi), an installer built with WiX 3, which adds the install directory to the system `PATH`

The x86_64 Windows launcher already runs on Windows 11 ARM through emulation. Windows 10 ARM does not provide that emulation, so it needs this build. The app image is larger than the x86_64 native launcher, because it ships a JVM.

Added by @warcholjakub in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4595

### Features
* Add --js-wasm-jspi and //> using wasmJspi to enable JSPI on Wasm by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4550
* Add arm64 `.deb` and `.rpm` artifacts by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4572
* Allow exposing ports when packaging through docker by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4586
* Build and publish a Windows ARM64 launcher and `.msi` package by @warcholjakub in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4595
* Bump `libsodiumjni` to 1.0.0 (was 0.0.5) & add support for publishing on arm64 runners by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4622

### Fixes
* Pick the Scala.js entry module deterministically when the linker emits multiple files by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4548
* Remove the multi-file Scala.js linked output directory recursively by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4549
* Prefer classic main methods over JEP 512 ones when inferring the main class by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4562
* fix: re-pin `lts` tags to the Scala 3 LTS versions configured in the build by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4576
* Fix `cli` `scaladoc` generation by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4599
* Don't walk directories on the class path by @lrytz in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4594
* Don't compile .jar inputs as sources with --server=false by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4596
* Don't fetch a Scala compiler for --java runs with nothing to compile by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4597
* Don't report power-mode-only options as unrecognized arguments by @sideeffffect in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4598

### Security
* Mitigate CVE-2026-91403: distrust compromised eMudhra CAs in JDKs and native launchers by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4575

### Compatibility
* refactor: migrate off deprecated `coursier` API in tests by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4561
* `config`: bump Scala to 3.9.0 LTS (was 3.3.9 LTS) by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4579
* Migrate from `coursier/publish` to `scala/scala-publish` by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4588
* GraalVM 25.0.2, `svm` 25.0.5.0.3 & JDK 25 (with `-release 17`) by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4593
* Bump `libsodiumjni` to 1.0.0 (was 0.0.5) & add support for publishing on arm64 runners by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4622

### Documentation
* docs: update installation methods by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4567
* Back port of documentation changes to main by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4568

### Build and internal changes
* Pin `vedantmgoyal9/winget-releaser` to a pre-bug commit sha by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4540
* Migrate from `vedantmgoyal9/winget-releaser` to running `komac` here by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4542
* Make `mill-native-image` and `mill-native-image-upload` source dependencies via a git submodule by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4543
* fix: filter out JVM log lines in integration test assertions by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4563
* Link `agentskills` for Claude Code, `.gitignore` the rest of config in `.claude` by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4577
* Split LTS integration suites into 3.9 LTS and (legacy) 3.3 LTS by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4587
* Don't fail CI when nightlies are not fetchable, only when they're wrong by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4603
* fix: time out hung native-binary tests and make munit's per-test timeout actually fire by @Gedochao in https://github.com/VirtusLab/scala-cli/pull/4608
